description: Find five-digit MSIC 2008 business activity codes by what the business does (e.g. "software development", "online shop", "cafe") or by the first digits of a code (e.g. "620"). Each match says what the code includes, officially. Once company_details is saved, get_business_classification suggests codes drafted from the customer's own description; use this to look up alternatives. The business classification step takes up to three codes.

query.description: Words describing the activity, or the start of a code.

name: search_msic_codes
title: Search MSIC codes
